@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: I think it'd be preferable for immersion/group use for the screenshot/snapshot to be via a spawnable in-game object with both a front (for "selfies") and rear (for traditional use) viewfinder. You could cut down on rendering costs by making the model simple, and only rendering the front/rear viewfinder for the user that spawned that particular camera. Additionally you could mark the camera for the user such that it would be easy for a user to identify "their" camera in a pile of spawned user cameras.

However, having this PLUS a quick in-menu "snapshot current user view" button would be nice. Maybe even a shortcut (trigger + menu button?) for quick captures.

details: Being able to move your current camera (eyes) to the same location of your ingame Menu (facing you) with a button toggle, would be a neat feature to see. This would allow you to take screenshots (selfies) of yourself. And also see your model without the need for a mirror. The Camera would attach to your characters HAND just like the Menu does. As every character regardless of bones can pull up a menu (albeit a static non-mobile one), I would be surprised if this was not possible.
